inspiration.observed_pattern: A package-state ingestion path uses a multi-row INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE and IF(VALUES(seq) > existing.seq, ...) guards so late events cannot overwrite a newer state.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent parcel checkpoint ledger. One multi-row upsert advances an existing parcel only for a higher checkpoint sequence, preserves an older row when a stale checkpoint arrives, and inserts a previously unseen parcel. SingleStore pipelines, procedures, and logistics schema are intentionally omitted.

fixture_notes: Parcel P-100 starts at checkpoint 5 and must advance to 7; a stale checkpoint 1 for P-200 must not change its checkpoint 2 state; P-300 is inserted by the same upsert.
determinism_notes: All parcel identifiers, sequences, locations, timestamps, and states are fixed. Final reads use parcel-key ordering; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE parcel_states (parcel_id VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, checkpoint_seq INT NOT NULL, location_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, next_location_code VARCHAR(16) NULL, recorded_at DATETIME NOT NULL, state_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO parcel_states (parcel_id, checkpoint_seq, location_code, next_location_code, recorded_at, state_kind) VALUES ('P-100', 7, 'HUB-B', 'HUB-C', '2025-03-01 10:00:00', 'in_transit'), ('P-200', 1, 'HUB-X', 'HUB-Y', '2025-02-28 23:00:00', 'in_transit'), ('P-300', 1, 'HUB-D', NULL, '2025-03-01 11:00:00', 'at_rest') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checkpoint_seq = IF(VALUES(checkpoint_seq) > parcel_states.checkpoint_seq, VALUES(checkpoint_seq), parcel_states.checkpoint_seq), location_code = IF(VALUES(checkpoint_seq) > parcel_states.checkpoint_seq, VALUES(location_code), parcel_states.location_code), next_location_code = IF(VALUES(checkpoint_seq) > parcel_states.checkpoint_seq, VALUES(next_location_code), parcel_states.next_location_code), recorded_at = IF(VALUES(checkpoint_seq) > parcel_states.checkpoint_seq, VALUES(recorded_at), parcel_states.recorded_at), state_kind = IF(VALUES(checkpoint_seq) > parcel_states.checkpoint_seq, VALUES(state_kind), parcel_states.state_kind)

checks.sql: SELECT parcel_id, checkpoint_seq, location_code, next_location_code, recorded_at, state_kind FROM parcel_states ORDER BY parcel_id
